name: Dark Council
summary: Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore has learned that the letter you brought came from a being who goes by Nagaz and belongs to the Argus Wake. If the Argus Wake is allied with the Syndicate, Maleb says, they must be a threat. You are sent to hunt down Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages in the Uplands.

sections.title: Envoys in the Uplands
sections.body: After Further Mysteries, Maleb tells you the letter came from a being who goes by Nagaz and belongs to the Argus Wake. Maleb does not know what the Argus Wake is, but an alliance with the Syndicate would make them a threat. Maleb wants Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages named in the letter found and killed, and asks for the head of Nagaz. You are to search the Uplands, north of Strahnbrad, where the Syndicate is strongest. Maleb hopes the Argus Wake's envoys are there.

sections.title: What Maleb Concludes
sections.body: Maleb finds it unwelcome that a group like the Argus Wake might run the Syndicate. Nagaz was only another's servant, Maleb adds, and the Argus Wake's reach may go deep across the continent, or even the whole world.

aliases: where to pick up dark council
faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore, who read the letter you brought him.

faq.q: Where are Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages located?
faq.answer: Maleb tells you to search the Uplands, north of Strahnbrad, where the Syndicate is strongest.
Maleb does not know. He only knows that Nagaz belongs to it and that, if it is allied with the Syndicate, it must be a threat.
It follows Further Mysteries, in which you brought the decrypted letter to Maleb.
